plainTranslation: A's love and values meets B's feelings. The square puts them in friction.
policy: Governed by synastry-policy. Descriptive, not deterministic; intensity is never treated as obligation, safety concerns override astrology.

summaryDeep: Their affection, preferences, and wish to keep things pleasant press against your feelings, needs, and sense of safety. It catches often enough that you both feel it, and it keeps asking to be worked out. Name it directly instead of letting it build in silence.
tension: Over time, these small misses can start to tell a bigger story. You may begin to think your needs are not important, while they may feel like nothing they do is ever enough. That is when a simple misunderstanding turns into resentment.
advice: Be direct. Tell this person what helps you feel cared for. Ask them what matters to them too. Stop grading each other on mind-reading. This connection gets stronger when you focus less on how love should look and more on whether it is actually reaching the other person.
summaryShort: Their affection, preferences, and wish to keep things pleasant press against your feelings, needs, and sense of safety.
